description: RETIRED WINDOW — kept as documentation, not a live grant. Settings moved in-frame (PR2); the 'settings' webview window is no longer created, so this capability set never applies to anything. It is retained to document the original MEDIUM-2 control: load_app_key (the command that returns the raw TfL API key) was gated to this window. The protection now rests on Rust-only custody instead — the renderer has NO loadAppKey wrapper at all, and load_app_key's window-label guard (commands.rs) is an inert backstop that rejects every caller. Do not delete this without also removing that guard and recording the change; do not assume webview-origin isolation for the key still exists.
